name: config-schema
//: The published config JSON Schema (served from GitHub Pages at its $id) — the contract every shipped config and the loader agree on. Its test validates the schema itself plus every config the project ships (examples/, owned by the root project, and the dogfood .allowlister.jsonc) against it; those files are inputs, so a change to them reaches this project without an edge to the crate. type:contract: it depends on nothing it serves.
